name: Redshift Native Experimentation
overview: Run experiments in LaunchDarkly using Redshift warehouse data to power your results.
description: Enable LaunchDarkly's experimentation platform to read and analyze data from your Amazon Redshift data warehouse
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Project and environment
formVariables.description: Select your LaunchDarkly project and environment. You cannot edit this after you save the configuration.

formVariables.name: Step 1: Add Endpoint and Cluster Identifier
formVariables.description: Enter the connection details for your Amazon Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Redshift endpoint
formVariables.description: The endpoint URL for your Redshift cluster (e.g., my-cluster.abc123.us-east-1.redshift.amazonaws.com).

formVariables.name: Redshift cluster identifier
formVariables.description: The unique identifier of your Amazon Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Redshift cluster region
formVariables.description: The region of your Amazon Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Redshift cluster AWS account ID
formVariables.description: The AWS account ID of your Amazon Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Step 2: Create IAM policy and IAM role
formVariables.description: Create the required AWS IAM resources to allow LaunchDarkly to connect to your Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: IAM policy
formVariables.description: This policy gives LaunchDarkly permission to read experimentation data from your Redshift cluster. Follow Amazon's documentation to create the required IAM policy.
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Continue setup in AWS IAM Console for Policies
instructions: Log into AWS and access the IAM section
Select Policies from the left sidebar
Select the create policy JSON option
Paste the above permissions policy into the policy document field and save the policy

formVariables.name: IAM role
formVariables.description: Follow Amazon's documentation to create an IAM role that LaunchDarkly will assume to perform the actions defined in your IAM policy from the previous step.
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Continue setup in AWS IAM Console for Roles
instructions: Log into AWS and access the IAM section
Select Roles from the left sidebar
Select custom trust policy, paste the provided trust policy and click next
Add the permissions policy created above, and save this role
Copy the ARN of the role and paste it in the IAM Role ARN field below

formVariables.name: AWS IAM role ARN
formVariables.description: The ARN of the IAM role that LaunchDarkly will assume to connect to your Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Step 3: Add metric details
formVariables.description: Create the required AWS IAM resources to allow LaunchDarkly to connect to your Redshift cluster.

formVariables.name: Metrics database name
formVariables.description: The name of your Redshift database where metrics events are stored.

formVariables.name: Metrics schema name
formVariables.description: The name of the schema within your metrics database.

formVariables.name: Step 4: Execute SQL script
formVariables.description: Continue setup in Redshift by running the script to prepare your Redshift account for native experimentation, then return to this page. This will create your DB, schema, user and grant permissions for experimentation.

formVariables.name: Part 1: Create DB, user and groups
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Connect to any database and run this script to create database, user and groups for experimentation

formVariables.name: Part 2: Grant ld_experimentation permssions
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Connect to ld_experimentation database and run this script to grant permissions for experimentation

formVariables.name: Part 3: Grant permissions to ld_export database
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Connect to ld_export database and run this script to grant permissions for experimentation

formVariables.name: Part 4: Grant permissions to metrics database
formVariables.instructionsHeading: Connect to your metrics database and run this script to grant permissions for experimentation

formVariables.name: Sync Task Id
formVariables.description: The task id of the sync task

formVariables.name: Event Last Seen Task Id
formVariables.description: The task id of the event last seen task

formVariables.name: Recurring Task Id
formVariables.description: The task id of the scheduled work task for this integration
